description: Change a storefront. Only the fields you send change; an empty string clears optional text. Set published to put it live or take it down. Only where the workspace has storefronts switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

contact_url.description: An https link where people reach you.

description.description: A paragraph on the seller and its offers.

logo_url.description: An https link to your logo.

offer_tags.description: Only functions with one of these tags. Empty lists every public function.

product_ids.description: Only these products open to offers. Empty lists every one.

published.description: true puts it live; false takes it down.

show_functions.description: List your public marketplace pricing functions.

show_negotiation.description: List your products open to offers.

subdomain.description: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.last-price.ai: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Some names are reserved.

tagline.description: One line on what it sells.

name: update_storefront
